name: Invoice Generator
description: Generate and manage synthetic invoices via DocumentGenerator API and Strapi CMS. Full CRUD on all content types, PDF generation with verification, and dataset statistics.

apiUrl.description: Base URL of the DocumentGenerator API (e.g., https://py.ascend-prod.regrapes.dev)

strapiUrl.description: Base URL of the Strapi CMS (e.g., https://ascend-prod.regrapes.dev or http://localhost:1337)

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts per invoice generation
